title: BGW evaluation preserves sharings
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type, let $d$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a resharer, and let $A$ be a finite set of parties with $2d+1\le |A|$. Suppose each input wire $i$ is assigned a degree-$d$ sharing of its value $v(i)$. Then, for every circuit $C$, the BGW evaluation of $C$ is a degree-$d$ sharing of the ordinary evaluation of $C$ on the values $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of parties
each input assignment is a degree-$d$ sharing of its corresponding value
